title: reseda alba var. valentina
intro: Reseda alba var. valentina, commonly known as White Mignonette, is a flowering plant species in the family Resedaceae. It is used as a medicinal herb, valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Reseda alba var. valentina include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. Its bioactive constituents include volatile oils, such as valerenic acid, valeranone, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
